authority: Colorado Department of Agriculture and Colorado Secretary of State

supportingRule.use: Authority and list-structure cross-check only. No event depends on unretained PDF bytes.

contradictions.subject: official-rule-access
contradictions.priorState: The source registry was blocked pending retained official rule bytes and row-level review of Lists A, B, and C.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The Secretary of State rule PDF was browser-readable but rejected the local direct client. The current Department of Agriculture page exposed Lists A, B, C, and Watch and was retained as a hash-verified browser DOM serialization.
contradictions.resolution: The Department page is the operative row-level artifact. The PDF is an authority cross-check only, and no accepted event depends on unretained PDF bytes.

contradictions.subject: browser-versus-direct-access
contradictions.priorState: Direct non-browser requests to both official Colorado endpoints returned access blocks.
contradictions.currentEvidence: A normal browser rendered the official Department page, and the serialized DOM contains 96 stable row-level taxon cards.
contradictions.resolution: The capture method is explicit in the registry and evaluation. The artifact hash, byte count, exact parser denominator, and deterministic replay protect the evidence lineage.

contradictions.subject: state-distribution-language
contradictions.priorState: The page groups some taxa by statewide distribution or population descriptions.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Those descriptions do not identify exact county evidence and do not satisfy an approved county-geography policy.
contradictions.resolution: Only state regulatory applicability was created. No county occurrence, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable claim was created.
